answer: Make every agent put down a small refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers catch it cheating. A sybil attacker spinning up a hundred copies then has to fund every single copy, so flooding the market stops being cheap. It works like a garden where each plot needs its own deposit, or a wharf where every berth is paid for in advance. A raven can steal one shiny coin, but it cannot fake a hundred wallets without paying for each one.
